impact: `_attest_candidate` is 101 lines and performs fresh rendering, geometry comparison, object-graph comparison, two semantic analyses, two rasterizations, page hashing, and contact-sheet verification inside one loop. A change to one attestation layer requires working among unrelated evidence stages and duplicated fresh/candidate state. I read the full function and promotion caller; no per-case attestation helper exists.
